title: Your First Weekend at University of Miami, Shared as Cards
description: A conservative, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through named Coral Gables campus spaces and public cultural programming.

cards.title: Start with the official self-guided route
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · 1306 Stanford Drive
cards.notes: Register if required, then use the University’s self-guided tour map to make a first pass through campus at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: Begin with an official framework for learning the Coral Gables campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Undergraduate Admission offers a self-guided walking tour and directs visitors to a digital campus map.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour | University of Miami Office of Undergraduate Admission
cards.access_notes: The source says registration is required and notes that some campus areas may be closed on weekends.

cards.title: Find the student-services hub
cards.subtitle: Friday · campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Walk through the Student Center to locate student-organization and Student Life offices before you need an appointment or event space.
cards.short_summary: A named center for student organizations, lounges, meetings, and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s self-guided tour identifies the Shalala Student Center as housing student-organization offices, lounge spaces, meeting rooms, and Student Life departments.
cards.source_title: University of Miami Self-Guided Tour Booklet
cards.access_notes: Access and room availability vary; consult the center or event calendar for a particular activity.

cards.title: Take the lakeside campus walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · beside the Shalala Student Center
cards.notes: Use the lake as a visual waypoint while connecting the Student Center, University Center area, and nearby academic buildings on foot.
cards.short_summary: A named lake setting along the Student Center portion of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s Coral Gables campus tour describes the Shalala Student Center as being set along Lake Osceola.
cards.source_title: Coral Gables Campus Tour | University of Miami
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor campus stop; follow posted campus guidance and use established paths.

cards.title: Locate the central library early
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 1300 Memorial Drive
cards.notes: Step inside Richter to identify the central library’s service points and make a note of where to return when coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: The Coral Gables campus’s central interdisciplinary library.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Library is the University of Miami’s central interdisciplinary library on the Coral Gables campus.
cards.source_title: Richter Library | University of Miami Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and hours can change; check the library’s current information before visiting.

cards.title: See the archives and Special Collections home
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Richter Library, 1300 Memorial Drive
cards.notes: Visit the first-floor Kislak Center to recognize its reading room and gallery, then save its collections for a future research project.
cards.short_summary: A campus center for Special Collections, University Archives, and the Kislak Collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kislak Center brings together Special Collections and University Archives with the Kislak Collection in Richter Library.
cards.source_title: About | Kislak Center at the University of Miami
cards.access_notes: Research services and gallery access are subject to library policies and current hours.

cards.title: Build in an art-gallery pause
cards.subtitle: Saturday daytime · 1301 Stanford Drive
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current visitor information, then give yourself time to view galleries without trying to rush the entire collection.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus art museum spanning thousands of years of human creativity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lowe Art Museum offers audiences resources for engaging with contemporary culture through 5,000 years of human creativity.
cards.source_title: Lowe Art Museum | University of Miami
cards.access_notes: Confirm current gallery hours, admission terms, and any ticketed-program details directly with the museum.

cards.entity_name: Patti and Allan Herbert Wellness Center
cards.title: Get acquainted with recreation options
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Coral Gables campus
cards.notes: Bring your Cane Card and check the facility’s current procedures before planning a workout, court time, swim, or recreation activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus fitness, recreation, and wellness facility with varied indoor and outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Herbert Wellness Center includes fitness, recreation, and wellness facilities such as a fitness room, pool, courts, track, and studios.
cards.source_title: Coral Gables Campus Tour | University of Miami
cards.access_notes: A valid University of Miami ID is required for use; membership or other access conditions may apply.

cards.title: Check the cinema’s next screening
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 5030 Brunson Drive
cards.notes: Look at the cinema schedule and choose a listed screening that fits your weekend; confirm ticketing and start time before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A single-screen campus art-house cinema that hosts films, festivals, and filmmakers.
cards.evidence_claim: Bill Cosford Cinema is a single-screen art-house cinema serving the University of Miami and greater Miami, with film programming and educational events.
cards.source_title: Bill Cosford Cinema | University of Miami Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Screenings, times, and ticket requirements differ by program; use the current cinema listing.

cards.title: Look for a Frost performance
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 1314 Miller Drive
cards.notes: Browse the Frost calendar for a listed concert at Gusman Concert Hall, then verify the program, time, and ticket terms before attending.
cards.short_summary: A named campus concert hall used for Frost School of Music performances.
cards.evidence_claim: University event listings place Frost School of Music performances at Gusman Concert Hall, 1314 Miller Drive.
cards.source_title: 2026 Stamps Jazz Quintet & Frost Sextet | University of Miami Events
cards.access_notes: Programs are event-specific; verify the current Frost listing for availability, age guidance, and cost.

cards.title: Save a recital hall for Sunday
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Knight Center for Music Innovation, 5513 San Amaro Drive
cards.notes: Use the current events calendar to see whether a Newman Recital Hall performance is scheduled, then plan around its published details.
cards.short_summary: A Knight Center recital venue used for Frost chamber and choral performances.
cards.evidence_claim: University event listings identify Newman Recital Hall at the Knight Center for Music Innovation as a venue for Frost performances.
cards.source_title: Frost Chamber Music Showcase IV | University of Miami Events
cards.access_notes: The cited showcase was a dated event; consult the current calendar for future programming and entry terms.
